name: /tinkerman abort
summary: Use when user runs `/tinkerman abort`, decides to abandon the current task, or needs to clear an active task slot before starting a new one.

name: /tinkerman accept
summary: Use when /tinkerman ship runs on a spec with acceptance_eval true, user runs /tinkerman accept explicitly, or /tinkerman ship --with-acceptance flag is provided.

name: /tinkerman build
summary: Use when running `/tinkerman build`, an approved plan exists, or the implementation phase of a standard or full tier task begins.

name: /tinkerman build-light
summary: Use when user runs `/tinkerman build` on a light-tier task, change touches 1 file and 20 lines or less, or has no spec or plan document.

name: /tinkerman charter
summary: Create, update, check, and display the project charter (.tinkerman/charter.md). Use when user runs /tinkerman charter <sub>.

name: /tinkerman continue
summary: Use when user runs `/tinkerman continue` — advance the current task to its next workflow phase without memorizing the phase sequence.

name: /tinkerman control-cli
summary: Use when running /tinkerman test --cli or when forge-test detects a CLI target.

name: /tinkerman control-ui
summary: Use when running /tinkerman test --ui or when forge-test detects a UI target with designer specs.

name: /tinkerman debug
summary: Use when user says debug this, reports a regression, or after three consecutive build failures trigger the three-strike reroute.

name: /tinkerman decide
summary: Use when starting a full-tier task, facing irreversible technical choices, or needing threat modeling before implementation.

name: /tinkerman decide-teams
summary: Use when `/tinkerman decide` is invoked and the topic involves architecture, security, cost, or product trade-offs requiring multiple viewpoints.

name: /tinkerman fix
summary: Use when running /tinkerman fix with bugfix.md + design.md + tasks.md workflow.

name: /tinkerman fix-conflicts
summary: Use when git merge or rebase produces conflicts inside the forge config tree.

name: /tinkerman forge-cmux-browser-qa
summary: Use when running /tinkerman test with browser-based QA via cmux (requires cmux installed).

name: /tinkerman forge-cmux-loop-signals
summary: Use when Forge Loop iterations are running and cmux sidebar signals are needed (requires cmux).

name: /tinkerman forge-cmux-sidebar-sync
summary: Use when Forge lifecycle state changes and cmux sidebar needs syncing (requires cmux).

name: /tinkerman grill
summary: Use when user starts full-tier task, says grill me, replies dig deeper during decide phase, or before locking an ambiguous spec.

name: /tinkerman init
summary: Use when user runs `/tinkerman init`, project has no .tinkerman/ directory, or plugin is installed but project not yet initialized.

name: /tinkerman learn
summary: Use when user runs `/tinkerman learn`, task completes, or needs to convert session experience into persistent knowledge assets.

name: /tinkerman loop
summary: Use when user runs /tinkerman loop, wants unattended execution, or needs background completion of queued tasks.

name: /tinkerman mutate
summary: Use when running `/tinkerman mutate`, verifying test quality after a build, or checking mutation score against threshold.

name: /tinkerman pack
summary: Use when running `/tinkerman pack <subcommand>`, enabling a domain pack in a project, or creating a new pack skeleton.

name: /tinkerman plan
summary: Use when running `/tinkerman plan`, a spec is locked, or an actionable task breakdown is needed before build.

name: /tinkerman recap
summary: Use when running /tinkerman recap to review recent activity.

name: /tinkerman refactor
summary: Use when running /tinkerman refactor (DEPRECATED — use /tinkerman build with work_nature=refactor instead).

name: /tinkerman replay
summary: Use when running `/tinkerman replay <topic>` to inspect the evidence chain for a task.

name: /tinkerman resume
summary: Use when user runs `/tinkerman resume`, a new session begins with prior work incomplete, or picking up interrupted work.

name: /tinkerman review
summary: Use when running `/tinkerman review`, build completes, or code changes need quality gate before ship.

name: /tinkerman review-comment-bitbucket
summary: Use when posting /tinkerman review findings to Bitbucket PR as tasks and inline comments.

name: /tinkerman router
summary: Use when user runs `/tinkerman <task>`, starts a new task, or needs skill dispatch across light, standard, or full workflow tiers.

name: /tinkerman ship
summary: Use when running `/tinkerman ship`, all review and test gates have passed, or a branch or pull request is ready to push.

name: /tinkerman spec
summary: Use when user runs `/tinkerman spec`, imports external PM spec, or building a new feature and lacks a locked spec.

name: /tinkerman status
summary: Use when user runs `/tinkerman status`, wants to see what tasks are in flight, or needs to know which phase a task currently sits in.

name: /tinkerman storm
summary: Use when running `/tinkerman storm <context>`, exploring a new Bounded Context, or building a domain model before writing specs.

name: /tinkerman test
summary: Use when user runs `/tinkerman test`, after build completes, or needs verification that behavior matches the locked spec.

name: /tinkerman triage
summary: Use when user runs `/tinkerman triage`, wants automated discovery of what to work on, or needs a periodic scan of Jira sprint / Bitbucket / git for actionable items. The 'discovery' action of loop engineering.

name: /tinkerman verify
summary: Use when user runs `/tinkerman verify <topic>` or during bugfix auto / debug Phase 4.

name: /tinkerman zoom-out
summary: Use when user says zoom out, gets lost in details during skill execution, or runs `/tinkerman zoom-out`.
